title: Wendell and the Asset
author: Noor Whitlock
blurb: Silas Galloway, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, has spent seven years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
